_comment: Enterprise managed config = org DEFAULT values plus an optional top-level 'locked' array. Deploy as 'managed-config.json' to the machine-wide admin path for all users (macOS: /Library/Application Support/Métis/ ; Windows: %ProgramData%\Métis\ ; Linux: /etc/asktoto/), or per-user (app userData dir). These paths must match exactly — the app reads only this location (adminManagedConfigPath in src/main/win-security.ts); a policy file anywhere else is silently ignored. Machine path wins over per-user. Any top-level setting key listed in 'locked' cannot be changed in-app by users. Malformed keys are ignored. Remove keys you don't want to preset. Governance keys (not user settings): 'allowedProviders' (array — confine LLM egress to approved vendors), 'escrowPubKey' (PEM — transcript escrow), 'disableAutoUpdate' (true — freeze the version fleet-wide for staged rollout). On Windows these are honored only from an admin-owned %ProgramData%\AskToto path (ACL-verified), never a user-writable one.
_comment_overlay: Overlay placement and chrome are ordinary settings keys, so they can be preset and locked like any other — useful when a fleet should get one consistent surface. 'overlayPlacement' is top-center|right-edge, 'overlayLayout' is hide|island|bar|dock, 'dockRest' is sliver|hidden and applies only to the dock (hidden = the dock paints nothing at rest; it stays exactly as reachable, since only opacity changes). A full bar cannot sit on the right edge: pair 'right-edge' with dock, island or a circle style, never with 'bar'.
